ExecutionPacket.purpose: Add or migrate one approved ConciseStudentTaskCard without source-contract, collection, graph, verification, or editor-evidence drift.

write-scope.file-7: optional collections/real-work/README.md for a confirmed real-work card

ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Only an AcceptedTaskCard from M-TASK-VALIDATION may enter M-TASK-LIBRARY. A ConciseStudentTaskCard uses the focused or real-work class, one fixed editor profile, one minimal copy-ready starter by default, exactly three closed hints, concise closed solution, and closed five-field metadata. A changed card synchronizes exactly one thematic collection, zero or one interview, supported real-work membership, graph, verification and Beads evidence. Until Phase 19, only the exact twenty named compatibility slugs may retain legacy structure, and compatibility is never concise migration PASS.
ExecutionPacket.graph-entry-excerpt: M-TASK-LIBRARY accepts output from M-TASK-VALIDATION, conforms to M-TASK-TEMPLATE, is governed by M-GOVERNANCE, and is projected into M-CATALOG.

dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-1: Authoring, synchronization, stop-condition, and Beads evidence rules.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-2: Focused and real-work concise shapes, five metadata labels and formats, editor profiles, minimal copy-ready and real-work FILE rules, exact hints, solution boundaries, and progressive disclosure.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-3: Strict candidate or migration decisions, exact compatibility inventory, CardMigrationEvidence, target-editor verdict, thematic/interview/real-work sync, and rendered evidence.

ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: Run V-M-TASK-VALIDATION, V-M-TASK-LIBRARY, V-M-CATALOG, and V-M-GOVERNANCE. Verify task class, editor profile, exact CardMigrationEvidence fields, minimal copy-ready code, exact hints, no legacy or full-document marker, target-editor expected/actual/verdict, local and supplementary links, exactly one thematic, zero-or-one interview, supported real-work membership, graph and verification sync, pushed commit, GitHub-rendered evidence, complete report, and technical publication status.

assumptions.assumption-1: The task has an accepted validation decision with task-appropriate evidence.
assumptions.assumption-2: The stable task slug, source learning goal, source prerequisite, source runtime assumption, selected task class, editor profile, five metadata fields, thematic/interview/real-work membership, assets, and supplementary links can be resolved before editing.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop when three useful hints are unavailable; code is not minimally copy-runnable; a file is undescribed; technology, editor, task class, or profile is ambiguous; multiple files are unnecessary or not real-work boundaries; FILE paths mismatch; a full-document JavaScript wrapper remains; an embedded asset replacement fails; metadata and collections drift; thematic, interview, or real-work membership is unsupported; a required link fails; GitHub renders unexpectedly; mandatory evidence is unavailable; or permanent tooling would be required.

notes.note-1: Workers should only read more context when the packet is insufficient.

CandidateValidationRecord.learning-goal: Independently authored one-sentence observable learning goal.
CandidateValidationRecord.decision-reason: Concise contract, quality, or duplication reason.
CandidateValidationRecord.wave-id: Wave child issue ID for accepted, otherwise none

CardMigrationEvidence.editorProfile: Programiz | CodePen | TypeScript Playground | React TypeScript
CardMigrationEvidence.sourceRuntimeAssumption: Exact source runtime, browser, classic or ESM, language, and framework assumption.
CardMigrationEvidence.destinationLocations: Exact concise condition, editor instruction, starter, hints, solution, metadata, thematic, optional interview and real-work collection, graph, and verification references.
CardMigrationEvidence.targetEditorExpectedResult: Observable expected output, interaction, type result, visual state, or real-work requirement set.
CardMigrationEvidence.targetEditorActualResult: Observed target-editor output, interaction, type result, visual state, or real-work requirement set.

CardMigrationEvidenceTemplate.record-rule: Store exactly these ten fields in the matching card Beads issue before PASS; missing or unavailable mandatory evidence keeps the card and wave open as BLOCKED.

StudentHubCutoverEvidence.root-blocks: Exactly Как пользоваться базой, Подборки по направлениям, Симуляции собеседований, and Где писать код.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.root-negative-checks: No old task table, metadata-source explanation, or agent-maintenance prose.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.collection-inventory: Exactly ten thematic and three interview README paths, all linked from the root hub.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.thematic-membership: Twenty unique task links; every task belongs to exactly one thematic collection.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.interview-membership: Fifteen unique task links; no task belongs to two interviews.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.editor-map: All four root URLs agree with the twenty fixed card profiles.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.graph-verification-sync: Every task export annotation names one thematic and zero-or-one interview collection; Phase 14 and Gate-Phase-14 are implemented.
StudentHubCutoverEvidence.phase-15-state: pending until the published GitHub-rendered audit passes.

compatibility-state.allowed-slugs: accessible-keyboard-tabs, browser-event-loop-order, container-responsive-grid, delegated-dynamic-list, discriminated-load-state, flex-long-text-overflow, idempotent-event-listeners, immutable-category-totals, loop-closure-bindings, modal-focus-lifecycle, react-batched-counter, react-derived-list, react-effect-subscription, react-strictmode-cleanup, response-union-narrowing, stable-product-sort, stale-search-response, this-callback-binding, typed-object-property, validate-unknown-profile
compatibility-state.permission: Legacy structure only; no concise structural, target-editor, wave, or rendered PASS.
compatibility-state.expiry: Remove atomically in Phase 19 only after all twenty-one concise cards pass.

ConciseMigrationTransition.Phase-16: Stage M-GOVERNANCE, M-TASK-TEMPLATE, M-TASK-VALIDATION, M-TASK-LIBRARY, and M-CATALOG target facts while observing twenty current legacy cards and thirteen current collections.
ConciseMigrationTransition.Phase-17: Migrate the exact eight-card focused Wave A with complete CardMigrationEvidence.
ConciseMigrationTransition.Phase-18: Migrate the exact eight-card focused Wave B with required browser, accessibility, and manual visual evidence.
ConciseMigrationTransition.Phase-19: Migrate four React cards, add users-api-list, cut over to twenty-one cards and fourteen collections, and then remove compatibility.
ConciseMigrationTransition.Phase-20: Audit the published thirty-six-page inventory and leave final user acceptance open.

target-inventory.collections: Exactly ten thematic, three interview, and one real-work page.
target-inventory.real-work-membership: Exactly users-api-list at the initial cutover, also present in one thematic collection and at most one interview.
target-inventory.formats: Написать код | Исправить код | Разобрать код | Предсказать результат | Приближённая к реальной работе

ConciseMigrationTransition.cutover-rejections: Reject legacy markers, a fourth hint, open details, a full JavaScript HTML document, invalid metadata, duplicate thematic membership, unsupported real-work membership, unavailable editor/browser evidence, or any mismatched graph, verification, and Beads fact.
ConciseMigrationTransition.blocked-when: BLOCKED whenever a required structural, editor, browser, DummyJSON, rendered, pushed-commit, or synchronization result is unavailable; never substitute compatibility or a diagnostic harness for PASS.

notes.note-1: Only list graph facts that really changed in repository artifacts.

module-checks.command-1: Verify accepted validation status or migration PASS, selected task class, five metadata labels and controlled values, editor profile, exact hints, closed details, absence of legacy markers, and mandatory concise anchors.
module-checks.command-2: Verify one minimal complete copy-ready block or justified real-work files with matching FILE paths; reject full-document JavaScript markup and resolve prerequisite, media asset, collection, and supplementary links.
module-checks.command-3: Verify exact CardMigrationEvidence fields and final target-editor expected result, actual result, and verdict plus applicable browser or manual visual evidence.
module-checks.command-4: Prove that the task slug appears in exactly one thematic collection, zero or one interview, supported real-work membership, one graph annotation, and matching verification and Beads facts.

required-evidence-anchors.marker-2: editor instruction / Условие / three exact hints / concise Решение / О задаче
required-evidence-anchors.marker-4: thematic, optional interview, graph, verification, and Beads sync

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: A task change must not complete before target-editor evidence and collection, graph, verification, and Beads synchronization are verified.

wave-follow-up.item-1: Compare card title, duration, format, editor profile, task class, thematic, optional interview and real-work entries, graph annotation, verification fact, and Beads evidence.

phase-follow-up.item-1: Run the full candidate and migration status, collection membership, vocabulary, XML, link, editor evidence, technical-publication, and GitHub-rendering review; prepare the complete library for final user acceptance.

FailurePacket.scenario: A concise migrated card, its target-editor evidence, and student collections disagree.
FailurePacket.preservation-ledger: Source learning goal, prerequisite, runtime assumption, and concise destination status.
FailurePacket.collection-sync: Expected thematic, optional interview, supported real-work, graph, verification, and Beads facts.

expected-evidence.marker-1: One complete ConciseStudentTaskCard, one thematic CollectionEntry, zero or one interview entry, supported real-work membership, and matching graph and verification facts.
expected-evidence.assertion-1: The task slug, student title, duration, editor profile, preserved source facts, and target-editor result must match exactly.

observed-evidence.artifact-1: The card or evidence record contains one fact.
observed-evidence.artifact-2: A collection, graph, verification, editor result, or Beads record contains a different fact or is missing.

FailurePacket.first-divergent-block: First card, editor, collection, graph, verification, or Beads fact that diverges.
FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Preserve the source learning contract, repair the first divergent fact, and rerun target-editor plus full synchronization checks without claiming PASS while evidence is unavailable.

evidence-captured.item-1: Card mode, editor profile, preservation ledger, target-editor expected/actual/verdict, thematic and optional interview entries, graph, verification, links, and Beads status agree.

CheckpointReport.editor-profile: Programiz | CodePen | TypeScript Playground | React TypeScript
